name: USER-G8-RUNTIME
status: User G8 integrated; controller G9 run 68a6f0745be1 validated real Gateway, User, Redis and isolated MySQL, two v2 events, test-consumer crash/recovery, Jaeger parent linkage and User resource attributes. See reports/microservices/g9-real-observed-68a6f0745be1/result.json. Real Agent and business consumer integration remains pending.

ports.management: USER_MANAGEMENT_PORT default 19092, bound 127.0.0.1; independent of service
ports.forwardedHeaders: server.forward-headers-strategy=none; proxy trust is not configured

nacos.namespace: USER_NACOS_NAMESPACE or NACOS_NAMESPACE; explicit non-public namespace
nacos.credentials: USER_NACOS_USERNAME and USER_NACOS_PASSWORD, or corresponding NACOS_* values, supplied externally as a pair where authentication is enabled
nacos.configBehavior: Only this field changes scheduled relay batch size. Missing, malformed or unavailable configuration makes readiness unavailable; last valid value remains in use. The generic Nacos ConfigData resolver is absent; arbitrary Nacos imports are rejected before any remote load.

tracing.endpoint: USER_OTLP_ENDPOINT must be HTTPS except loopback HTTP
tracing.event: session-revoked-v2.schema.json; traceparent-only captured on original durable intent transaction
tracing.propagation: W3C trace context only; baggage and baggage correlation disabled

legacyCompatibility: Existing stored v1 event_json is replayed byte-for-byte. Existing intents use version 1 and retain no captured producer context; old unmaterialized outbox facts serialize v1. Newly recorded intents produce v2, with optional producer traceparent. Recovery and replay do not recapture relay context.

governance.authority: feign:delegationAuthority#resolve; explicit authority denial remains 403, limit/dependency failure 503
governance.readiness: Enabled governanceRules must report UP. Observability export failure does not determine readiness.

security: No secrets or bearer tokens in config documents, URLs, metric labels, spans or manifest. Authority readiness reports configured/health unverified, never asserts external domain authority is healthy.

combinedOptIn.scope: Explicit verify namespace, loopback non-3306 empty MySQL and loopback OTLP. Events mode enables Gateway and User observability with independent loopback management ports; the first successful logout goes through Gateway and the failure/restart case goes directly to User. Manifest is fsynced before network and records exact stream, probe prefix, known session keys, owned process IDs, both management ports and validated User producer traceparents with route labels. An interruption during login is marked loginInProgress; an unreturned session ID cannot be precisely cleaned from this manifest and expires naturally. Stream remains for controller consumer. An interruption between process creation and PID persistence is marked processStarting; review exact executable and port before intervening.
combinedOptIn.redisCommands: Session read: GET. Session writer: SET NX EX and DEL. Business verification: SET NX EX, GET, DEL. Relay: XADD exact stream; probe: MULTI, XADD, PEXPIRE, EXEC, DEL against exact probe prefix. Connection handshake AUTH/HELLO and CLIENT SETINFO as required. No SCAN, XTRIM or ACL mutation.
combinedOptIn.jaegerQuery: Explicit HTTP origin with literal 127.0.0.1 and port; no credentials, query, fragment or non-root path. The test appends /api/traces/{traceId}, limits response bytes and request time, retries 404/empty data, and waits for the exact User producer span (plus a Gateway span for the Gateway-routed logout) before process restart.

combinedNacosOptIn.status: Prepared for controller execution; actual User/Gateway/Nacos combination has not been run or validated by this change.
combinedNacosOptIn.execution: From the repository root invoke Maven through Python with: mvn -pl knode-user -am test -Dtest=ExternalStackIT -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false -Dknode.it.real.enabled=true -Dknode.it.events.enabled=true -Dknode.it.nacos.combined.enabled=true -Dknode.it.gateway.jar=<absolute-built-gateway-jar> -B -ntp. Set credentials only in the subprocess environment, never in arguments or the manifest.
combinedNacosOptIn.otherRequiredInputs: All database, Redis, event stream, OTLP, Jaeger and Gateway JAR inputs in combinedOptIn remain required. This scenario deliberately uses an owned loopback connection-closing sink for the User OTLP endpoint to verify export failure does not affect readiness; it does not validate User trace export or query Jaeger.
combinedNacosOptIn.guards: Both modes default false. Requires an exclusive newly isolated authenticated Nacos instance, numeric 127.0.0.1 address with explicit non-8848 port and room for the 1000-port gRPC offset, two distinct verify-* namespaces, and explicit VERIFY_* discovery, config and governance groups. The confirmation is an operator assertion, not proof of exclusivity. Never use public, old namespaces or guessed credentials. Nacos version, authentication switch and exclusive ownership are controller-provided preconditions; this test uses explicit SDK credentials but does not independently prove those server properties.
combinedNacosOptIn.preinitialized: The controller must initialize the published Gateway route template in the config group, empty Gateway flow/API-group and User flow/degrade rules in the governance group, and a valid User relay Data ID in the config group. The distinct other fresh namespace must contain a valid relay Data ID under the same config group. The primary User discovery group must be empty. No namespace or ACL is created by this test.
combinedNacosOptIn.cacheAndManifest: The manifest is fsynced before any Nacos client, publication or process launch. Inputs, namespace/group, exact Data IDs, controlled previous/new contents and restore outcomes are recorded without credentials. Nacos test, User and Gateway SDK snapshots/logs use separate fresh target directories with snapshot initialization disabled; only the owned cache directory is removed. Unknown concurrent content is never overwritten during restoration; inspect the manifest on failure.
combinedNacosOptIn.scenario: Actual User and Gateway are started with discovery, fixed config and governance enabled; no SimpleDiscovery or business provider fixture. The test checks real readiness and authenticated Gateway/User requests, SDK discovery isolation, other-namespace relay isolation observed for six seconds, 0 -> ready 503 -> 2 -> ready 200 -> 0 -> ready 503 and actual two-of-three logout outbox publications, recovery to 3, missing and invalid flow retention/readiness recovery, and an exact User HTTP flow rule causing direct and Gateway 429 followed by recovery.
combinedNacosOptIn.timing: The test uses a controlled 180-second initial relay delay and 60-second poll interval. It refuses the batch check if startup/configuration takes too long and requires the outbox to remain unpublished before invalid configuration is observed. The run can take several minutes. After two publications, it observes the count for eight seconds before asserting the last-known-good batch limit.
combinedNacosOptIn.cleanup: Stops only owned services and the owned exporter-failure sink, restores only exact known modified configuration values in both verify namespaces, shuts down SDK clients, removes only the recorded owned cache, deletes only recorded/new User session keys and preserves the exact test stream for controller handling. If a config value has changed unexpectedly, restoration refuses overwrite and reports cleanup failure.
